field.label: Match
field.help: The device's MAC address (preferred — survives DHCP changes) or its IPv4 address.

field.label: Name
field.help: Display name, overriding whatever DHCP/DNS reports.

field.label: Vendor
field.help: Display vendor, overriding the OUI lookup and any probe result.

field.label: Type tag
field.help: Device type, e.g. phone, laptop, iot. "auto" leaves it to the classifier.

field.label: Daily quota (GB)
field.help: Per-device daily quota. Blank inherits the global setting.
